description: Save job matches to the user's saved list so they can come back to them. Pass 1 to 25 job_match_ids from getmattered_get_matches. Saving does not apply: nothing is sent to any employer and nothing is spent. It can be undone with getmattered_unsave_matches. Do not use it to apply; use getmattered_apply. Next: getmattered_get_matches with saved_only to list the saved jobs.

job_match_ids.description: Job match ids from getmattered_get_matches, 1 to 25 (e.g. [48213, 48214]).

name: getmattered_save_matches

action.description: The operation that ran: save, skip, unsave or restore.

title: Save Job Matches
